output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix may apply if configured
output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with Certificate resources (cert-manager.io/v1) and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD installed. The v1.18.0 upgrade includes a fix for Cloudflare DNS01 challenge issuance. However, the environment summary does not show whether any Issuers or ClusterIssuers use the Cloudflare DNS01 provider. Inspect your Issuer and ClusterIssuer resources to confirm whether Cloudflare DNS01 is configured; if so, this fix applies to your environment.
